posts.cooked:
Nobody talked about the Citizen Dawn Monty Haul problem? I disagree with the mathematical answer for basically the reason Adam gave, but more importantly, it’s obvious that Dawn would absolutely not switch, because it would mean admitting her first guess was wrong, and she’d rather disown her daughter than admit to being wrong that her daughter was going to have powers.

They said in this episode that Mist Storm Lifeline left the timeline with Jansa, but he was bursting with Aeon Master power because he never created Aeon Girl. I don’t think Jansa would want him in the removed Enclave while so explosively overpowered, and certainly him being such a grim dark edgelord of a character makes him too fitting for Mist Storm not to have used during that line if it had continued.

Apparently C&A don’t want a do-over on their life. They are the exact polar opposites of me. I’m reasonably pleased with my current life despite many things having gone horribly wrong (eg my house), but in spite of everything that’s ever been good, all I can think about is the mistakes and lost opportunities and the cases where I wish I had known. I would sign any number of Aeturnus contracts if I could get to relive my entire life with perfect knowledge of the future that would unfold. I have to accept that that vision is impossible, yet I need that impossible vision to cope with everything I’ve endured.
